program.name: Neck & Traps
program.subject: Neck & traps
program.blurb: Neck and traps every day in supersets: a gentle neck hold paired with shrugs or upper-back work.
program.about: Neck and traps every day, in supersets. Each pair starts with a gentle neck hold or a prone neck lift, then a trap move: shrugs and carries one day, Y raises and reverse snow angels the other. The neck work stays at half effort, building a neck that sits well and handles a long day at a desk. Abs finish every session; Level II makes the holds longer and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Neck & loaded traps / neck & upper back
